profile.headline: Image generation known for readable text, with editing apps and an API

capabilities.title: Create and edit in one workspace
capabilities.text: Ideogram Creative moves from first prompt to finished asset with its models, Ideogram Studio and purpose-built apps.

capabilities.title: Get readable type in images
capabilities.text: The site stresses prompt fidelity and crystal-clear type in every layout.

capabilities.title: Add image generation to a product
capabilities.text: The Ideogram API handles image and video models through one endpoint.

capabilities.title: Use it from your agents
capabilities.text: Connect Ideogram to Claude, Cursor and other MCP clients so agents can generate, edit and train.

featureCards.name: Creative apps
featureCards.text: The list includes Precise Edit, Ad Resizer, Background Remover, Colorways, Material Swap and Object Remover.

featureCards.name: Several models
featureCards.text: Ideogram Vector, Ideogram 4.5, 4.0 and 3.0 are listed.

featureCards.name: Custom image models
featureCards.text: Listed among the models and tools on the site.

featureCards.name: One API
featureCards.text: Authentication, billing and integrations stay in place, and you switch models by changing one string.

featureCards.name: Enterprise
featureCards.text: Enterprise-grade security, legal indemnification, unlimited seats, custom SSO and dedicated support.

audienceDetail.text: The Enterprise section is written for teams producing visual work at scale.
The API is for adding image generation and editing to a product.
The MCP connection brings generation into agent workflows.

scenarios.title: Make a poster with real lettering
scenarios.text: The site's own API example asks for a poster for a summer design conference.

scenarios.title: Prepare a product image
scenarios.text: Use the listed apps such as Background Remover, Colorways and Material Swap.

scenarios.title: Adapt an ad
scenarios.text: The Ad Resizer app is listed for resizing ads.

scenarios.title: Automate image work in an agent
scenarios.text: Call Ideogram through MCP from a tool such as Cursor or Claude.

gettingStarted.text: Use the Get started button on ideogram.ai.
Open Ideogram Creative and try the apps.
Build with the API and read the docs.
The site offers a demo request and a sales contact for Enterprise.
